customer_complaint: Customer reports squealing noise from front wheels when braking at low speed.
technician_diagnosis: Measured front brake pad thickness: 1.2mm remaining on both inner pads (minimum specification 2.0mm). Outer pads at 3.1mm. Rotors show minor scoring, measured within resurfacing tolerance.
diagnostic_findings: Front brake pad thickness 1.2mm inner; 3.1mm outer; rotors within resurfacing tolerance.
repair_outcome: Pads replaced, rotors resurfaced. Noise eliminated.

actual_repair_performed.excerpt: Pads replaced, rotors resurfaced. Noise eliminated.

customer_complaint: Customer reports engine overheating after 20 minutes of highway driving.
technician_diagnosis: Cooling system pressure test held at 16 PSI for 15 minutes, no external leaks found. Thermostat opens at 195F within specification. Water pump removed for inspection: impeller blades show significant cavitation damage and reduced flow capacity.
diagnostic_findings: Impeller blades show significant cavitation damage.
repair_outcome: Water pump replaced. Cooling system refilled and bled. Temperature stable.

actual_repair_performed.excerpt: Water pump replaced. Cooling system refilled and bled.

customer_complaint: Customer complained of engine rattling during acceleration.
technician_diagnosis: Root cause identified as timing chain tensioner failure.
actual_repair_performed: Timing chain, tensioner and guides replaced.
repair_outcome: Timing chain tensioner replaced. Noise resolved.

technician_diagnosis.excerpt: Root cause identified as timing chain tensioner failure.

actual_repair_performed: Timing chain replacement performed including guides and tensioner.
repair_outcome: Timing chain kit replaced. Noise resolved.
